sio2_melting_3.name: Melting of SiO2 - Level 3
sio2_melting_3.description: Simulate the melting of alpha quartz SiO2. Use the reaxff potential. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 2 times in each direction. Detect the solid → liquid phase transition during the heating stage and report the mean-square displacement (MSD) of atoms at the transition point in Å².
